jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
\# Business Analyst

\#\# Job Summary

We are seeking a detail\-oriented and analytical Business Analyst to join our team. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to understand business needs, gather and document requirements, and support the delivery of high\-quality technology solutions. The Business Analyst will play a key role in improving business processes and ensuring that solutions align with organizational goals.

\#\# Key Responsibilities

\* Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements.

\* Conduct stakeholder interviews, workshops, and requirement elicitation sessions.

\* Translate business needs into clear functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

\* Analyze existing business processes and identify opportunities for process improvement.

\* Create and maintain business requirement documents (BRDs), functional requirement documents (FRDs), process flows, and use cases.

\* Work closely with product owners, project managers, developers, QA teams, and solution architects throughout the project lifecycle.

\* Support Agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, and user story grooming.

\* Assist in defining project scope, priorities, and business objectives.

\* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by preparing test scenarios, coordinating with business users, and validating delivered functionality.

\* Identify project risks, issues, and dependencies, and recommend appropriate solutions.

\* Ensure delivered solutions meet business requirements and quality standards.

\* Maintain comprehensive project documentation and communicate project status to stakeholders.

\#\# Required Qualifications

\* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

\* 3–7 years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar role.

\* Strong understanding of business analysis methodologies and best practices.

\* Experience gathering and documenting business and functional requirements.

\* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.

\* Experience working in Agile, Scrum, or Waterfall project environments.

\* Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.

\* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

\#\# Preferred Qualifications

\* Experience with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Visio, or similar collaboration and documentation tools.

\* Knowledge of SQL and basic data analysis.

\* Experience working on digital transformation or enterprise application projects.

\* Familiarity with API integrations and system interfaces.

\* Business Analysis certifications such as CBAP, CCBA, or ECBA are a plus.

\#\# Key Skills

\* Requirements Gathering and Analysis

\* Business Process Modeling

\* Stakeholder Management

\* User Story Writing

\* Functional Documentation

\* Process Improvement

\* Agile/Scrum Methodologies

\* UAT Planning and Support

\* Communication and Presentation Skills

\* Critical Thinking and Problem Solving

\* Risk Analysis and Decision Making

\#\# What We Offer

\* Competitive salary and benefits

\* Opportunities for professional growth and career development

\* Collaborative and inclusive work environment

\* Exposure to innovative technologies and challenging projects

\* Flexible work arrangements, where applicable

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**Role description**  

Product Owner (Mid\-Level)


**Experience Required:** 3\-5 Years **Job Type:** Full\-Time



Job Summary



We are looking for a **mid\-level Product Owner** with 3\-5 years of experience to own the product backlog for one or more product areas, translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements, and work closely with cross\-functional Agile teams to deliver value iteratively. * Domain experience relevant to the hiring team's industry (e.g., fintech, e\-commerce, SaaS, healthcare)


Soft Skills


* Strong communication and interpersonal skills across both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Analytical, detail\-oriented, and comfortable making prioritization trade\-offs

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager, Data
jobs.description:
**About Fairground**


Fairground is a B2B GTM data platform. We ingest, enrich, and structure millions of company and contact records across verticals, and turn them into reliable go\-to\-market signal inside our products. Data is the product — and how well we build the pipeline behind it is the business.

**Why this role exists**


Right now our data work — ingestion, enrichment, vertical expansion, quality — is spread across engineers with no single owner defining *what* to build or *in what order*. This role owns that. You'll be the person who turns a backlog of data projects into a sequenced, shipped roadmap, and who makes sure engineering builds the right thing the first time.


This is a high\-leverage hire: the projects you unblock touch nearly every workflow in the product.

**What you'll do**

* Own the data platform roadmap end to end — ingestion, enrichment, matching, vertical data models, and the sync between our warehouse, CRM, and products
* Turn ambiguous data problems into fully\-specced, buildable projects
* Prioritize ruthlessly across a large backlog: which verticals, which data sources, which quality fixes come first, and why
* Own the data quality feedback loop — define how we catch bad data before customers see it, and drive the process to fix it
* Evaluate and manage third\-party data and enrichment vendors — coverage, quality, cost — and make build\-vs\-buy calls
* Keep an eye on the cost side: AI and enrichment spend is a growing driver of COGS, and roadmap decisions move that number
* Partner tightly with engineering, design, and GTM to ship — and be the connective tissue between what customers need and what the pipeline can deliver

**What we're looking for**

* 5\+ years in product management, with real depth on data products, data infrastructure, or technical/platform PM work
* Technical fluency: you can read a schema, reason about pipelines and data models, and hold your own with engineers on trade\-offs
* A track record of shipping, turning messy, ambiguous problem spaces into sequenced roadmaps that get built
* Strong instincts for data quality and entity resolution: what "good data" means and how to defend it at scale
* Experience with third\-party data vendors or enrichment is a strong plus
* Comfort operating with high autonomy in a fast\-moving, early\-stage environment
* Bonus: B2B GTM / sales\-tech domain experience

**Why Fairground**


You'll own the roadmap for the layer that *is* the company. It's the highest\-leverage seat on the product team — what you unblock ripples across the entire platform. High ownership, direct customer and revenue impact, and a team moving fast.

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer II, Planning Intelligence
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Customer experience is at the heart of all we do at Amazon, as we strive to be Earth's most customer\-centric company. Amazon Customer Service (CS) is at the forefront of customer experience, working relentlessly to provide customers a convenient, high quality, and delightful experience — across all of our CS channels — in every interaction.  

  

Within CS, Network Solutions is responsible for designing, planning, and operating the world's largest customer service network — building intelligent, adaptive systems that anticipate demand, match customers to optimal experiences. We are transforming CS from a manually operated, reactive model into an AI\-native ecosystem that makes CS a growth driver and competitive advantage for Amazon.  

  

We are seeking a Software Development Engineer (SDE2\) to join Planning Intelligence (PI) — the AI\-native brain of Amazon CS. Our team builds the predictive intelligence that defines how CS creates value: forecasting demand at granular levels in real\-time, powering autonomous planning and what\-if scenario simulations, shaping network design, and optimizing resource allocation to deliver the customer and business outcomes that matter most.  

  

The ideal candidate will own the design, implementation, and delivery of software that enables these capabilities. You will build distributed systems that plan autonomously, simulate scenarios to evaluate tradeoffs, and optimize resource allocation across the network — directly shaping how millions of customers experience Amazon's support.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Scope \& Software Design: You deliver software features and improvements to major portions of your team's software — spanning new development, refactoring, and deprecation. You design solutions that enable new capabilities or improve existing systems, aligned with your team's long\-term architectural strategy. You work with customers and stakeholders to understand business value and ensure you deliver the right solutions. You document how your team's software is constructed, tested, and operated, and actively train new teammates.  

  

Execution \& Operational Excellence: You are a significant contributor to the full software development lifecycle — scoping, design, code, testing, deployment, and maintenance. You don't settle for the status quo, routinely identifying opportunities to improve your team's operations. You actively participate in code reviews, providing meaningful feedback to senior engineers and seeking early feedback on your own work. You ensure root causes of operational issues are identified and resolved with permanent fixes.  

  

Problem Solving \& Impact: You work on difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks, bringing clarity and identifying simple designs for solutions. You make effective priority tradeoffs between feature development and operational work. You mentor other engineers and resolve disagreements through constructive dialog.  

  

A day in the life  

You design and deliver software features that power planning and optimization for Amazon's global customer service network. You write and review code daily, contribute to design discussions, and make tradeoffs between speed and quality. You collaborate with Scientists, Product Managers, and business teams to turn requirements into well\-designed, maintainable software. You own your services end\-to\-end \- from design through operations \- and when things break, you dig deep to find root causes and drive permanent resolution. You mentor teammates, improve team processes, and keep your skills current. Your work directly impacts how millions of customers experience Amazon's support.  

  

About the team  

Planning Intelligence is the world leader in providing cost\-optimal, AI\-driven solutions that enable customers to get best\-in\-class human support while raising the bar on associate experience. We are responsible for: 1\) Planning customer support staffing through autonomous, AI\-native systems. 2\) Preserving customer experience through intelligent, outcome\-based network planning. 3\) Ensuring optimal costs through real\-time resource optimization. Our team crafts comprehensive workforce management plans by combining predictive intelligence, scenario simulation, and scientific optimization \- moving from reactive, manual planning to systems that continuously learn, adapt, and deliver the right outcomes at scale.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Role Overview** 




  





 This is a deeply technical, delivery\-focused Product Manager role. You will own the product end\-to\-end and act as the connective tissue between customers, engineering, design, go\-to\-market (GTM), and leadership teams.
 



 We are looking for a systems thinker and a closer—someone who can move seamlessly from a customer conversation to a whiteboard, to a PRD, to a shipped and measurable feature while thriving in structured chaos.
 



 Equally important, you are the person who gets things done. You build trust with clients, translate ambiguity into clear solutions, drive technical teams to deliver on time, and turn even the sparsest customer input into precise, build\-ready requirements.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities** 




**Roadmap \& Strategy** 



* Define, prioritize, and evolve the product roadmap from vision through delivery and iteration.
* Balance customer needs, business objectives, and technical feasibility when making prioritization decisions.



**Project Management \& Delivery** 



* Own the full delivery lifecycle, including planning, scoping, sequencing, risk management, and on\-time releases.
* Manage timelines, dependencies, and trade\-offs across multiple workstreams and stakeholders.
* Run effective sprint planning, backlog grooming, and delivery cadences to keep work unblocked and progressing.
* Maintain scope, quality, and deadlines while communicating status and risks clearly to leadership.



**Client Engagement \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Build strong, trust\-based relationships with clients and serve as a credible and confident point of contact.
* Lead discovery conversations, product demonstrations, and feedback sessions while representing the customer’s voice internally.
* Manage expectations across customers and internal stakeholders, negotiating scope and priorities when necessary.



**Solutioning** 



* Translate ambiguous business and customer problems into clear, practical solution options.
* Partner with engineering teams on solution design, technical trade\-offs, and the path from problem to product.
* Clearly define the "what" and "why" so the team can confidently own the "how."



**Requirements \& User Stories** 



* Take minimal customer input—sometimes just keywords or a rough idea—and expand it into complete, well\-structured user stories, acceptance criteria, and requirements.
* Fill gaps intelligently by inferring intent, identifying edge cases, and validating assumptions before they reach the team.
* Produce clear PRDs and user stories that engineering and design teams can execute with minimal back\-and\-forth.



**Driving Technical Execution** 



* Drive outcomes through the technical team, influencing engineers without relying on formal authority.
* Engage deeply in architecture discussions, technical trade\-offs, and system design decisions.
* Remove blockers, hold teams accountable to commitments, and ensure roadmap execution.



**Data, Design \& Performance** 



* Use product analytics, customer feedback, and business metrics to inform prioritization decisions.
* Partner with UX/UI teams to improve usability, workflows, and overall customer experience.
* Define, monitor, and report on KPIs such as activation, retention, expansion, and revenue impact.



  





**Requirements** 




**Technical Depth** 



* Ability to explain product architecture, data flows, and database design decisions.
* Comfortable discussing and debating technical trade\-offs with engineering teams.
* Familiarity with cloud\-native systems, APIs, and distributed architectures.



**Delivery \& Project Management** 



* Proven track record of delivering complex, multi\-team initiatives on time.
* Strong command of project management fundamentals, including planning, dependency management, risk management, and stakeholder communication.



**Client Engagement \& Solutioning** 



* Demonstrated ability to engage directly with clients, build trust, and manage long\-term relationships.
* Skilled at transforming vague or keyword\-level input into clear solutions and build\-ready requirements.



**End\-to\-End Ownership** 



* Proven ability to own a product roadmap and make difficult decisions under ambiguity.
* Able to clearly articulate personal contributions to product decisions and business outcomes.



**Execution \& Impact** 



* Strong structured problem\-solving skills with the ability to break down complex issues.
* Demonstrated impact through measurable outcomes, such as:
* Improved product adoption or retention by
 *X%*
* Increased ARR or revenue by
 *X%*
* Reduced delivery timelines by
 *X%*
* Improved operational efficiency or customer satisfaction by
 *X%*

 Fairground is a B2B GTM data platform. We ingest, enrich, and structure millions of company and contact records across verticals, and turn them into reliable go\-to\-market signal inside our products. Data is the product — and how well we build the pipeline behind it is the business.
   

  

**Why this role exists**
 Right now our data work — ingestion, enrichment, vertical expansion, quality — is spread across engineers with no single owner defining
 *what* 
 to build or
 *in what order* 
 . This role owns that. You'll be the person who turns a backlog of data projects into a sequenced, shipped roadmap, and who makes sure engineering builds the right thing the first time.
   

  

 This is a high\-leverage hire: the projects you unblock touch nearly every workflow in the product.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the data platform roadmap end to end — ingestion, enrichment, matching, vertical data models, and the sync between our warehouse, CRM, and products
* Turn ambiguous data problems into fully\-specced, buildable projects
* Prioritize ruthlessly across a large backlog: which verticals, which data sources, which quality fixes come first, and why
* Own the data quality feedback loop — define how we catch bad data before customers see it, and drive the process to fix it
* Evaluate and manage third\-party data and enrichment vendors — coverage, quality, cost — and make build\-vs\-buy calls
* Keep an eye on the cost side: AI and enrichment spend is a growing driver of COGS, and roadmap decisions move that number
* Partner tightly with engineering, design, and GTM to ship — and be the connective tissue between what customers need and what the pipeline can deliver


**What We're Looking For**
* 5\+ years in product management, with real depth on data products, data infrastructure, or technical/platform PM work
* Technical fluency: you can read a schema, reason about pipelines and data models, and hold your own with engineers on trade\-offs
* A track record of shipping, turning messy, ambiguous problem spaces into sequenced roadmaps that get built
* Strong instincts for data quality and entity resolution: what "good data" means and how to defend it at scale
* Experience with third\-party data vendors or enrichment is a strong plus
* Comfort operating with high autonomy in a fast\-moving, early\-stage environment
* Bonus: B2B GTM / sales\-tech domain experience


**Why Fairground**
 You'll own the roadmap for the layer that
 *is* 
 the company. It's the highest\-leverage seat on the product team — what you unblock ripples across the entire platform. High ownership, direct customer and revenue impact, and a team moving fast.

Senior Manager, Analytics Products \& Technology
   

  

**Obesity Intelligence \& Analytics \| Amgen India**

 Role Summary
   

  

 This is an India\-based global role supporting Amgen's global obesity business. The Senior Manager, Analytics Products \& Technology will own the development and evolution of business\-facing products that enable leaders to move from insight to action with clarity and speed.
   

  

 It is a product leadership role at its core \- requiring strong judgment, technical fluency, and a deep understanding of how leaders make decisions. The focus is on creating products that simplify complexity, accelerate decisions, and meaningfully improve how the organization operates.
   

  

 This leader's mandate is to build products that serve as critical enablers of how the business plans, prioritizes, and executes. This leader will shape their direction, ensure they evolve with the needs of the organization, and drive adoption in a way that makes them indispensable to everyday work.
   

  

 The role also plays a key part in advancing AI\-enabled capabilities and intelligent automation across the organization. As new opportunities emerge, this leader will help bring them to life in a way that is practical, scalable, and grounded in real business impact \- ensuring that innovation translates into meaningful change, not experimentation for its own sake.
   

  

 Success is measured by products that become part of how the business runs—trusted, widely adopted, and consistently making work faster, simpler, and more effective.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
The Product Owner (PO) within Kroll’s Chief Data Office (CDO) is accountable for the end‑to‑end ownership, delivery, and adoption of enterprise data products. This role serves as the single point of accountability for product vision, stakeholder alignment, roadmap execution, and experience quality across assigned data domains.
   

  

 The Product Owner partners closely with
 **Business stakeholders, Data Engineering, BI/Reporting, Data Science, Governance, and Platform teams** 
 to ensure data products are reliable, intuitive, scalable, and aligned with Kroll’s strategic priorities. The role emphasizes
 **clarity of ownership, predictable delivery, and measurable business impact** 
 in a complex, enterprise data environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Ownership \& Accountability**
* Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for enterprise data, analytics, or AI product areas.
* Serve as the single point of accountability for product outcomes, delivery health, and user experience.
* Define and communicate product goals, success metrics, and value drivers to stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Ensure products operate with clear ownership, release discipline, and lifecycle management, behaving like true products—not one‑off projects.


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Business Alignment**
* Act as the primary interface between the CDO and business, finance, and functional leaders for assigned domains.
* Partner with stakeholders to prioritize demand, manage tradeoffs, and align delivery to business timelines.
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements without compromising data integrity or architectural standards.
* Establish and maintain trusted relationships that enable fast decision‑making and alignment.


**Backlog, Roadmap \& Delivery Management**
* Own and maintain a prioritized, well‑defined backlog with clear acceptance criteria and readiness standards.
* Work with Program Managers, Scrum Masters, and delivery teams to plan releases and manage dependencies.
* Balance short‑term delivery needs with long‑term product health, scalability, and maintainability.
* Surface risks, constraints, or scope trade‑offs early to enable leadership decisions.


**Governance, Quality \& Standards**
* Partner with Data Governance, Data Stewards, and Platform Owners to ensure:
+ Consistent KPI definitions and metric logic
+ Data quality, lineage, and trust standards
+ Alignment with enterprise data architecture and security policies

* Ensure products meet operational readiness standards prior to release and are supported post‑launch.


**Adoption, Value \& Continuous Improvement**
* Drive product adoption by ensuring solutions is intuitive, reliable, and aligned to real user workflows.
* Define and track usage, adoption, and value realization metrics.
* Collect feedback and iterate to continuously improve product experience and impact.
* Support leadership by providing a clear narrative on what is delivered, what value it creates, and what comes next.


**Required**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, Analytics, or Data‑centric roles.
* Proven ability to own roadmaps, backlogs, and stakeholder relationships in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of data, reporting, analytics, or BI platforms (e.g., Power BI, Databricks, data warehouses).
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models with engineering and analytics teams.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate between business objectives and technical execution.


**Preferred**
* Experience in a Chief Data Office, Analytics, or Enterprise Reporting organization.
* Familiarity with data governance, semantic models, KPI standardization, and self‑service analytics.
* Experience supporting finance, operations, or enterprise‑wide reporting domains.
* Prior experience working in a vendor‑heavy environment and helping transition to more internal ownership.


**Leadership Behaviors \& Expectations**
* Operates with clear ownership and accountability.
* Brings structure, clarity, and discipline to ambiguous problem spaces.
* Makes trade‑offs explicitly and escalates decisions appropriately.
* Focuses on outcomes and value, not just delivery.
* Trusted partner to both business leaders and technical teams.


**Why This Role Matters**
 The Product Owner is a
 **critical enabler of CDO’s product‑led operating model** 
 , ensuring that data and analytics investments deliver consistent, trusted, and measurable value to the firm—while reducing dependency on informal workarounds, fragmented ownership, and vendor‑driven execution.

Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
  

  

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.
  

  

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full\-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.
  

  

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  

  

Why Syneos Health
  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.
**Job Responsibilities**

**Job Summary**

The Salesforce Engineer II, Service Cloud / Health Cloud designs, develops, configures, tests, and supports Salesforce solutions for Syneos Health’s Service Cloud, Health Cloud, REMS, and Engagement Center platforms. This role focuses on case management, patient and HCP workflows, REMS processes, enrollment, service operations, user experience, automation, reporting support, and platform configuration.


The role works closely with the Senior Salesforce Engineer, Salesforce architecture, product owners, business stakeholders, QA, validation, operations, and platform support teams. * Work with business analysts and product owners to refine requirements and convert them into maintainable Salesforce solutions.
* Partner with QA and validation teams to support test planning, defect resolution, regression testing, and release evidence.
* Troubleshoot production issues and service requests related to Salesforce configuration, automation, access, data, and user experience.
* Participate in code reviews, design reviews, sprint ceremonies, and release readiness activities.
* Assist in documenting system functionality, technical designs, configuration decisions, and support procedures.
* Follow Syneos standards for secure development, least privilege access, auditability, data protection, and regulated platform delivery.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
* 3 or more years of Salesforce development or administration experience.
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Flow, Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, permission sets, custom objects, validation rules, and platform configuration.
* Experience supporting Service Cloud, Health Cloud, Experience Cloud, or similar CRM business processes.
* Experience troubleshooting Salesforce defects and supporting production users.
* Understanding of Salesforce security, including profiles, permission sets, field\-level security, sharing, and role hierarchy.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Salesforce Platform Developer I certification.
* Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.
* Salesforce Service Cloud Consultant or Health Cloud Accredited Professional.
* Experience with REMS, patient services, healthcare, life sciences, contact center, or regulated workflows.
* Experience building technical documentation and support procedures for enterprise platforms.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps, SFDX, Git, and Salesforce deployment tools.

**Get to know Syneos Health**

  

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.


No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

jobs.description:
**Role description**  

This is a Test scenario creation and execution\-focused (hands\-on) contract role for a professional with **at least 10 years of experience**. You will be dedicated to verifying applications built upon Salesforce, Bullhorn, C\+\+ and can largely be accessed via API as well as different interfaces. Your primary focus (\~75%) will be safeguarding quality through meticulous test design, complex system integration testing (SIT), and manual exploratory testing. The remaining (\~25%) of your time will be spent creating API tests for testing the integration of application Iplan with x\-one.


Alongside execution, you will serve as a supportive senior presence on the test floor.


**What will you do within the x\-one program?**

**Functional \& End\-to\-End Testing Core (\~75% of the role):**

* **Test Script Design:** Independently draft advanced test scripts in Gherkin within TestRail based on global release notes and local user stories.
* **Hands\-on Execution:** Execute deep manual functional, configuration, and exploratory tests to validate business\-critical flows on Salesforce and iPlan
* **Integration \& SIT Validation:** Validate complex local connections (such as API\-driven endpoints via Boomi or Apigee) to ensure data integrity across the entire local E2E chain.
* **Defect Management:** Log and track formal software defects thoroughly inside Jira, acting as a strong sparring partner for developers during re\-testing.
* **Acceptance Support:** Actively support local business streams and users during Functional Acceptance Testing (FAT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by preparing test data and helping guide execution.
* **Team Mentorship:** Support, train, and coach junior and medior QA testers on\-the\-job to enhance their testing techniques and functional analysis skills.

**Test Automation Support (\~25% of the role):**

* **Risk\-Based Selection:** Analyze delivered epics to identify the highest\-risk business scenarios and tag them within TestRail for inclusion in the automated regression suite.


 **Pipeline Execution:** Trigger and run automated smoke tests and API test scripts (using tools like ) immediately following environment deployments to ensure platform stability. **Automation Collaboration:** Collaborate closely with dedicated Test Automation Engineers, flagging when existing automated scripts require refactoring due to changes in application UI or workflows.
* **API \& Microservice Savvy****:**Deep experience with automated testing of REST APIs and navigating a microservices/domain services architecture (using libraries such as like RestAssured or similar).

**Who will you collaborate with?**

* **Reporting line:** You will report directly to the local Test Manager / Domain Manager of the x\-one program.
* **The Project Team:** Work daily alongside internal QA Testers, dedicated Automation Engineers, Developers, and Product Owners within your agile squad.
* **Stakeholders:** Connect with local Dutch IT domain experts (RGN IT), global business flow leads, and global QA counterparts to sync on release expectations.

**What do you bring?**

**Requirements:**

* **Experience:** A minimum of **10 years of proven experience** as a Test Analyst or QA Engineer in large\-scale, complex enterprise environments.
* **SaaS Ecosystems:** Demonstrable experience testing within Salesforce implementations and connected platform tools
* **Analytical Mindset:** Strong capability in applying risk\-based testing methodologies, such as Product Risk Analysis or Risk Poker frameworks.
* **Tool \& Method Sync:** Strong working knowledge of **Jira, TestRail, and Gherkin syntax**.
* **Automation Context:** Practical familiarity with writing, running and analyzing automated API tests
* **Languages:** Fluent at writing and speaking in English (essential for navigating local integrations and global organizational alignment).

 **Skills** **Mandatory Skills :** User Acceptance Testing  

**Good to Have Skills :** Salesforce Sales CPQ/CLM Cloud Testing

Salesforce Testing  

API Testing (REST APIs)  

SIT (System Integration Testing)  

Manual / Functional Testing  

TestRail  

Gherkin  

JIRA  

UAT / FAT  

10\+ Years QA / Testing Experience  

Secondary Skills  

REST Assured  

Microservices Testing  

Boomi / Apigee  

Exploratory Testing  

Risk\-Based Testing  

Automation Testing Exposure  

Bullhorn / iPlan Experience  

Agile/Scrum Environment  

  

Recruiter Screening (Must Have):  

  

Salesforce \+ API Testing \+ SIT \+ TestRail \+ Gherkin \+ JIRA \+ Manual/Functional Testing \+ 10\+ Years Experience.

**ABOUT AMGEN**
Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting\-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.

**Role Description:**


The Associate Dev/Ops position offers a unique opportunity to join a fun, innovative engineering team within the AI \& Data Science (AI\&D) organization. You’ll work on next\-generation capabilities and services in Applied AI \& Automation using innovative COTS products, open\-source software, frameworks, tools, and cloud computing services. The role also emphasizes demonstrating these capabilities to support critical business operations and initiatives, in ensuring quality, compliance, and performance across Amgen’s Applied AI \& Automation Footprint.


The Associate Dev/Ops role contributes to the design, development, testing, and implementation of Intelligent Automation solutions that support business needs. This role works closely with architects, testers, engineers, and business analysts to help deliver high\-quality, scalable automation solutions using modern technologies. The engineer is expected to have foundational knowledge of system architecture, strong problem\-solving skills, and the ability to clearly communicate technical concepts, while continuing to build expertise in Intelligent Automation and Agile delivery practices under guidance from senior team members.

* Contribute to the design, development, testing, and deployment of automation workflows using UiPath, Power Automate.
* Assist in integrating AI services and APIs into automation pipelines for use cases such as document processing, summarization, and workflow decisioning.
* Develop and maintain automation components, scripts, and connectors using Python, JavaScript, or similar languages under guidance.
* Support CI/CD pipelines for automation and AI solutions, including build, deployment, and environment promotion activities.
* Assist with monitoring, logging, and basic performance analysis of automation and AI services.
* Participate in incident response and troubleshooting activities, escalating issues as appropriate.
* Support solution availability, reliability, and cost\-awareness initiatives.
* Work as part of a global team of automation and DevOps engineers contributing to enterprise AI \& Automation solutions.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand\-ups, and retrospectives.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including architects, testers, business analysts, and product owners to deliver incremental value.
* Follow established enterprise architecture, security, and data governance standards.
* Support validation activities and documentation required for regulated (GxP) environments.
* Ensure solutions adhere to defined development, testing, and deployment best practices.
* Stay current with emerging DevOps, automation, and Applied AI technologies.
* Contribute to documentation, knowledge sharing, and internal demos under guidance.
* Continuously improve technical and professional skills through hands\-on experience and mentoring.

**Basic Qualifications and Experience:**

**\[GCF Level 3]**

* Any degree and 2 to 5 years of Computer Science, IT or related field experience

**Functional Skills:**

**Must\-Have Skills:**

* Hands on experience in Intelligent Automation platforms such as UiPath or Power Automate.
* Foundational experience with DevOps, automation, or software engineering concepts.
* Basic programming or scripting experience (e.g., Python, JavaScript).
* Understanding of Agile methodologies and team\-based delivery models.
* Willingness to learn enterprise DevOps, automation, and AI solution engineering practices.

**Good\-to\-Have Skills:**

* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS.
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools and version control systems.
* Introductory knowledge of AI/ML or GenAI concepts and services.
* Experience working in regulated or compliance\-driven environments.

**Soft Skills:**

* Excellent critical\-thinking and problem\-solving skills
* Strong communication and collaboration skills
* Demonstrated awareness of how to function in a team setting
* Demonstrated awareness of presentation skills

**Shift Information:**


This position requires you to work a later shift and may be assigned a second or third shift schedule. Candidates must be willing and able to work during evening or night shifts, as required based on business requirements.

Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.


We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

jobs.description:
Job Description:
**What we are looking for**
---------------------------


We are seeking a software\-quality engineering leader who has personally written code, built automated test frameworks and led test teams. This is not a manual QA management role. The ideal candidate understands software architecture, CI/CD, automation pipelines, system testing, industrial product validation and how to partner with senior development managers so quality is engineered into the product rather than inspected at the end.**About the Role**
------------------


This manager role will lead the transformation of testing into a modern quality engineering discipline for industrial automation software. The leader will manage test engineers and automation engineers, define the test strategy, embed quality gates into pipelines, expand automation coverage and work as a strong functional partner to the two Grade 9 Senior Software Engineering Managers. The role should be technically credible and influential, while reflecting a scope one level more focused than the senior software engineering manager roles.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead software test, automation, validation and quality engineering talent reporting into the Hyderabad organization.
* Own the quality\-engineering strategy across control software, modern platform products, system integration and release readiness.
* Partner with development managers to make quality a shared engineering responsibility, not a downstream QA function.
* Improve automated testing coverage, CI/CD quality gates, regression cycle time, defect prevention and release confidence.
* Coach test engineers toward stronger coding, automation, framework development and system\-quality skills.

**Team Leadership**
-------------------

* Lead, mentor and grow test engineers into modern quality engineers with strong coding, automation, system thinking and product\-quality orientation.
* Recruit talent capable of building frameworks, writing robust automated tests and influencing developers technically.
* Create an environment where test engineers collaborate early with developers, product owners, UX, systems engineers and architects.
* Operate with strong functional leadership while partnering with Grade 9 senior engineering managers on quality strategy, release readiness and engineering discipline.

**Technical Leadership**
------------------------

* Define test architecture for complex products spanning mature control software, modern cloud/platform components, APIs, front ends and system integration.
* Guide automation strategy across unit, API, service, UI, integration, hardware/edge\-in\-the\-loop where relevant, regression and exploratory testing.
* Partner with MBSE/System Engineering to connect requirements, system behavior, verification strategy and automated validation.
* Use AI\-assisted testing where valuable, including test\-case generation, test\-data generation, defect triage, log analysis and automation maintenance.

**Project Management**
----------------------

* Plan test cycles, automation roadmap, resourcing and release\-readiness activities in lockstep with the development organizations.
* Track and report quality risks, automation progress, release confidence and improvement plans to engineering and product leadership.
* Manage day\-to\-day quality execution with a practical, hands\-on operating style appropriate for a functional manager role.

**Communication and Collaboration**
-----------------------------------

* Act as a technically credible quality partner to both Senior Software Engineering Managers, collaborating on quality standards early in design and development.
* Partner with UX and Product Management on acceptance criteria, usability validation and user\-facing quality bars.
* Communicate quality risks and release readiness clearly to technical leaders and non\-technical stakeholders.

**Continuous Improvement**
--------------------------

* Continuously improve automated coverage, pipeline reliability, regression time, defect prevention and quality metrics.
* Shift the organization from manual validation dependency toward continuous, automated and risk\-based confidence building.
* Use engineering metrics such as DORA, escaped defects, flaky\-test rate, automation coverage, cycle time and release\-readiness indicators to drive improvement.

**Tools \& Project Management**
-------------------------------

* GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI or equivalent CI/CD tooling; Jira; Confluence; GitHub Enterprise.
* Automation frameworks such as PyTest, Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Robot Framework, CppUTest, JUnit, NUnit or comparable tools.
* Static analysis, code coverage, test reporting, artifact management, containerized test environments and observability/log\-analysis tools.

----------------------------

* 12\+ years of software engineering, quality engineering, test automation or validation experience, including substantial hands\-on coding experience.
* 3\-5\+ years of people leadership experience managing test engineers, SDETs, automation engineers or quality engineering teams.
* Strong programming experience in one or more languages such as Python, C\#, C\+\+, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript or similar.
* Proven experience designing and implementing automated test frameworks and integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with system/integration testing for complex software products, preferably including industrial automation, embedded/edge systems, OT software or regulated environments.
* Working knowledge of TDD, BDD, test pyramid, contract testing, performance testing, security testing, static analysis and release\-quality metrics.

* Experience translating data into insights and recommendations for business or operational stakeholders
* Experience communicating findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Experience working in a cross\-functional, matrixed environment

jobs.description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.


If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.


HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.


We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist


 In this role, you will:

* Work collaboratively within agile, multi\-skilled teams to design and deliver world\-class data solutions that serve customer needs
* Elicit, analyze, and translate business change, functional, and non\-functional requirements from diverse stakeholders into technical specifications
* Create and maintain comprehensive logical and physical data models that adhere to governance standards and fulfill both business and technical requirements
* Perform detailed metadata analysis including entity naming conventions, attribute definitions, data types, and data lineage documentation
* Conduct end\-to\-end user journey analysis to understand system requirements beyond functional scope
* Own the production of analysis and modeling artifacts that enable development teams to deliver working solutions
* Act as the critical liaison between business and technical teams, bridging gaps and facilitating successful project delivery


To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements:

* 10\-14 years of progressive experience in data analysis and data modeling with a strong track record in financial domain expertise
* Advanced proficiency in comprehensive data modeling methodologies (conceptual, logical, and physical), following agreed data governance and standards
* Expert\-level skills in requirements gathering, gap analysis, effort estimation, and ability to translate high\-level business requirements into technical database designs and data mappings
* Proven expertise in metadata management, ensuring accuracy, completeness, consistency, traceability, and validity of all data\-related artifacts
* Strong individual contributor with solid understanding of SDLC, Agile methodologies, and ability to work independently with a sense of ownership
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills with demonstrated ability to build rapport across organizational levels
* Problem\-solver with a solution\-seeking mindset, capable of thriving in fast\-paced, continuously evolving environments
* Technical proficiency in SQL, MS\-Office tools, GCP BigQuery, Erwin, and Visual Paradigm (preferred)


You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.


www.hsbc.com/careers


HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. jobs.title: Business Analyst

As a Business Analyst, you will work closely with business users to gather requirements and document current (AS\-IS) procedures and new (TO\-BE) processes. You will perform gap analysis and provide options, risks, and impacts on other processes or systems. Acting as a bridge between the People/HR Team and Technology/IT Teams, you will prepare user guides (Quick Reference Guides) and work with the change communication team to ensure that each step in the process is documented for end users.
   

  

**The Day\-to\-day Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To**
* Work with the Technical Analyst and development team to ensure they understand the specifications.
* Identify, assess, and document business requirements, recommending business priorities and advising on options and risks.
* Act as the subject matter expert and provide in\-depth systems expertise from a functional perspective in a support capacity for new initiatives and projects.
* Assist business users, project managers, and IT leadership in optimizing the scope, benefits, and risks of projects/tasks assigned.
* Develop strong partnerships with key stakeholders in Accounts Payable and Human Resources.
* Business process issue resolution.
* Prepare functional specifications for development.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 3\-5 years of experience in business analysis or a related role, preferably with exposure to Oracle applications.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and provide actionable insights.
* Basic understanding of business processes and how they align with technology solutions.
* Familiarity with Oracle E\-Business Suite or Oracle Cloud applications.
* Experience with data analysis tools such as SQL or Excel.
* Exposure to project management methodologies and tools


**Must\-Have Skills**
* Excellent presentation, oral, and written communication skills, including meeting and workshop facilitation experience.
* Good knowledge of all HR business processes (Hire to Retire, Talent Management, Compensation and Benefits, etc.).
* Minimum of 3 \- 5 years’ experience in documentation of business processes.
* Proficient knowledge of Oracle Cloud HCM.


**Technical Skills**
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel and PowerPoint.
* Basic knowledge of SQL for data querying and reporting.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst - CRM
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**




 We are seeking a proactive, detail\-oriented Sr. Analyst to join our Global Marketing team, supporting both Demand Generation and Sales. This role focuses on managing and optimizing our in\-house CRM and marketing automation (Marketo) team, maintaining the data quality in Salesforce, and ensuring leads are accurately routed and tracked. The Sr. Analyst will play a key role in helping the marketing and sales teams execute high\-impact campaigns and generate a qualified pipeline. This is a growth opportunity for someone looking to become a true team leader while gaining hands\-on experience in a global B2B environment. A strong focus of the role will be identifying and implementing automation opportunities to streamline and scale current database management processes and tasks. Experience managing a team is desired.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**



* Oversee Salesforce CRM operations, ensuring high data quality, accurate lead routing, campaign attribution, and strong governance across leads, contacts, and accounts.
* Own and optimize marketing automation platforms (e.g., Marketo), including campaign execution, lead scoring, segmentation, and nurture programs to improve engagement and conversion.
* Drive campaign execution and performance tracking, ensuring accurate campaign setup, attribution, and continuous improvement based on ROI and conversion metrics.
* Establish and monitor KPIs, dashboards, and reporting frameworks to provide actionable insights on lead quality, campaign effectiveness, and sales alignment.
* Maintain Salesforce data quality: deduplication, data standardization and appending contact and firmographic details.
* Conduct secondary research to enrich database records with verified information.
* Run basic Salesforce reports to support marketing campaign tracking, sales alignment, and list building.
* Collaborate with the demand generation team to segment audiences and support email and digital marketing initiatives.
* Identify and implement automation solutions for database management and marketing operations processes.

This role is responsible for strengthening InvoiceCloud’s ability to sustain critical operations and recover quickly from disruptive events that may impact customers, technology platforms, or business processes.
   

  

 As a subject matter contributor in continuity and recovery planning, this individual partners with business leaders, Engineering, Infrastructure/Cloud Operations, Security, and Product teams to conduct business impact analyses, define recovery objectives, develop and test playbooks, and drive measurable improvements in resilience readiness.

Success in this role means reducing resiliency gaps, validating recovery capabilities through testing, and ensuring BC/DR artifacts are audit\-ready, actionable, and aligned to business priorities.
   

  

**Success Profile**

**Results Driven**
* Leads Business Impact Analysis (BIA) \& Resilience Planning by identifying critical processes, services, dependencies, and acceptable downtime thresholds, ensuring continuity priorities align to customer impact and business risk.
* Defines and validates Recovery Objectives \& Strategy (RTO/RPO) for critical services, confirming backup, replication, and resiliency controls meet required recovery targets and coordinating remediation where gaps exist.
* Executes structured Testing, Exercises, and Continuous Improvement initiatives—including tabletop simulations, functional exercises, and technical recovery tests—producing after\-action reports and measurable readiness improvements.

* Communicates program status, resilience risks, and recovery\-readiness insights to Security leadership, ELT stakeholders, and the CISO, ensuring transparency and accountability across the organization.


**Drives Efficiency**
* Standardizes documentation templates, dependency inventories, RTO/RPO tiering models, and reporting formats to improve consistency, audit readiness, and stakeholder clarity.
* Implements structured corrective\-action tracking with defined owners, evidence requirements, and measurable closure timelines to reduce resiliency gaps systematically.
* Streamlines enterprise Testing, Exercises, and Continuous Improvement workflows to ensure learnings from incidents and simulations translate into actionable improvements.
* Brings order to complex cross\-functional recovery planning by aligning business\-unit expectations, technical recovery capabilities, and regulatory guidance into practical, sustainable processes.


**Innovative**
* Applies structured analysis and scenario modeling to identify disruption patterns, hidden dependencies, and resilience blind spots that may not be visible through standard documentation reviews.
* Leverages AI and automation tools to enhance plan governance, corrective\-action tracking, dependency mapping, and reporting workflows—improving efficiency, scalability, and real\-time visibility into recovery readiness metrics.

This role centers on developing integrations, automations, APIs and custom components across CyberArk Privileged Access Manager, CyberArk Secrets Manager and CyberArk Secrets Hub. Best\-in\-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category\-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next\-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead.

jobs.description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full\-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision \- to simplify payments for Indian businesses \- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
   

  

 Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
   

  

 From building AI\-native agentic payments, to AI\-assisted fraud detection and real\-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners \- including banks, networks, regulators \- we are pioneering industry\-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
   

  

 Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation \- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
   

  

 Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early\-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
   

  

 Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180\+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme \- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
   

  

 We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India \& SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions \- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards\-first UPI) \- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
   

  

 But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen \- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle \- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People \> Pedigree \- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles \- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy \& Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000\+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a PM2, you will independently own a product area or platform charter end\-to\-end — from strategy and roadmap to execution and business impact. You will operate with significant autonomy and drive initiatives across customer experience, platform scalability, automation, growth, and monetisation. You will be expected to think beyond features and solve for systems, operational leverage, and long\-term platform evolution.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Build Customer Empathy \- Regularly engage with customers, internal stakeholders, and ecosystem partners to deeply understand pain points, workflows, and unmet needs through both qualitative and quantitative insights.
* Drive Product Strategy \- Define long\-term product vision and quarterly roadmap aligned withbusiness goals, customer outcomes, and platform scalability.
* Build Scalable Products \- Collaborate with engineering, design, analytics, and operationsteams to build reliable, scalable, and high\-impact products.
* Lead Product Execution \- Write high\-quality product specifications, prioritize effectively,manage tradeoffs, and ensure timely execution across releases.
* Own Metrics \& Outcomes \- Define success metrics, monitor business impact, and drive iterative improvements through experimentation and data analysis.
* Ecosystem Collaboration \- Partner with banks, regulators, vendors, and ecosystem players to co\-build industry\-defining solutions.


**What Weʼre Looking For**
* 4–7 years of product management experience
* Strong product execution and prioritization skills
* Experience owning business metrics and customer outcomes
* Strong analytical thinking and experimentation mindset
* Ability to work across technical and business stakeholders
* Systems thinking and platform orientation
* Strong customer empathy balanced with business acumen
* Ability to thrive in ambiguity and fast\-paced environments


 Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.

 Opportunity: The IN B2B market is made of 63 MM Micro \& Small Customers and 0\.5MM Medium \& Large customers together spending $400B annually. That is the market segment that the Amazon Business team is creating solutions for.
   

  

 Problem: Over the past many years, individual shoppers in India have come to appreciate the convenience, infinite selection and competitive pricing that Amazon offers.

That is because the needs of the Indian businesses are different from that of individual shoppers and the current state of consumer\-oriented B2C platforms does not fully address the requirements of a business purchase. That is the problem that the PM team at Amazon Business intends to solve. We intend to make buying online as simple, reliable and cost\-effective for businesses as it is for individuals.
   

  

 This means that the PMs in Amazon Business India have to re\-look at every aspect of the customer's journey \- browsing, selection, price display, checkout, payment, delivery and returns experience and enhance them to fir the needs of the business customer. In addition, the team has to build new products \- approval workflows, GST compliance, multi\-user accounts, spend analytics reports etc. to address unique requirements of Indian business customers. jobs.description:
**Description**


Synaptics is leading the charge in AI at the Edge, bringing AI closer to end users and transforming how we engage with intelligent connected devices, whether at home, at work, or on the move. As the go\-to partner for the world’s most forward\-thinking product innovators, Synaptics powers the future with its cutting\-edge Synaptics Astra™ AI\-Native embedded compute, Veros™ wireless connectivity, and multimodal sensing solutions. We’re making the digital experience smarter, faster, more intuitive, secure, and seamless. From touch, display, and biometrics to AI\-driven wireless connectivity, video, vision, audio, speech, and security processing, Synaptics is the force behind the next generation of technology enhancing how we live, work, and play.

 **Overview**


Synaptics is looking for a Principal Program Manager to join our Global Operations team. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in semiconductor design and manufacturing processes, coupled with exceptional program management skills. As the ASIC Program Manager, you will oversee the entire product lifecycle from concept through production, working closely with cross\-functional teams including design, verification, validation, and manufacturing to ensure timely delivery of high\-quality ASICs. The successful candidate will play a key project leadership role, acting as the primary owner of SOC program execution on the project planning scheduling, inter\-team coordination, status tracking and reporting. Sr. Director, Program Management.

  



**Responsibilities \& Competencies**


Job Duties

* Own end\-to\-end program management of engineering programs from idea to mass production including planning, scoping, design, development, and change management
* Lead and coordinate all aspects of ASIC development programs from requirements gathering through to final product release, including design, verification, validation, and production rampup
* Work closely with internal engineering teams (ASIC design, firmware, validation, etc.), external partners, and vendors to manage deliverables and ensure alignment on project goals and schedules
* Support the teams in issue resolution and risk mitigation through well balanced and efficient processes leveraging tools and automation
* Actively support sustainable, effective cross\-functional communication at multiple levels in the organization
* Analyze technical issues and lead the team in generating creative mitigation options and solutions
* Act as the primary point of contact between engineering, product management, and senior leadership, providing regular status updates on program progress, issues, and risk management
* Monitor and manage the program budget, ensuring projects are delivered within financial constraints
* Manage relationships with operation team and external ASIC vendors, ensuring that they meet technical and delivery requirements
* Ensure proper documentation of program processes, designs, and decisions throughout the ASIC development lifecycle
* Drive continuous improvement of all processes, methodologies, and systems


Competencies

* Well organized with strong attention to data and detail; proactively ensures work is accurate
* Ability to ask difficult but important questions and drive discussion to find answers
* Ability to influence horizontally across multiple internal functional organizations
* Developing talent, ability to inspire and excite team
* Highly structured planner with a strong discipline towards pragmatic and efficient processes
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with expertise in agile execution and facilitating multiple projects simultaneously
* Ability to synthesize and report complex matters simply for senior and executive management to grasp quickly
* Good verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work within a diverse team

 **Qualifications** (Requirements)

* Bachelor's (Master’s preferred) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field or equivalent
* A deep understanding of ASIC design, verification, and manufacturing processes is essential.
* 15\+ years of experience in Program Management, including 5\+ years of expertise in engineering program management Experience in rigorous life\-cycle management including capturing requirements, decomposition, architecture, design, unit testing and integration testing among others
* Proven expertise in planning tools and methodologies (Jira, MS Project / SCRUM, waterfall)
* Hands\-on technical experience preferred
* No travel required

 *Belief in Diversity*  

*Synaptics is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to workforce diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, or genetic information.*

jobs.title: Group Product Manager, Google Play
jobs.description:
**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 5 years of experience in taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end\-to\-end, 0 to 1, etc.).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
* Experience with Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools or product development.
* Experience in gaming, game design, or the gaming industry.
* Experience with working in multi\-sided marketplaces, user and developer services.
* Experience in building and scaling global consumer products.
* Excellent narrative, storytelling, internal and external communications skills.


**About The Job**
 At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
   

  

 In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
   

  

 One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.
   

  

 Google Play Games multi\-year plan is driving substantial growth in the business by building the tools, experiences, and infrastructure to supercharge gaming for users and developers. We're moving with speed, enhancing the team’s creativity and capabilities with the Google’s Artificial Intelligence (AI) infrastructure, tools, and services, and driving a culture of innovation and team empowerment.
   

  

 Google Play offers music, movies, books, apps and games for devices, powered by the cloud. It syncs across devices and on the web. As part of the Android and Mobile team, Googlers working on Google Play do everything from engineering our backend systems, to shaping product strategy, to forming great content partnerships. They make it possible for people to do things like buy an ebook or song on their Android phone, then have it instantly available on their laptop. The Google Play team enhances the Android ecosystem by giving developers and partners a premium store where they can reach millions of users.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead a focused cross\-functional team in quickly prototyping, testing, building, and launching a brand\-new experience for gamers.
* Be the single point of accountability from concept to launch, landing, and scaling.
* Lead with urgency through deep technical and cross\-functional ambiguity with positivity. Bring the energy every day to turn "maybe" into "ship it."
* Architect a global product strategy and influence executives and stakeholders around it. Orchestrate global impact, and own syncs to drive delivery, spanning time zones.
* Use and advocate for the latest tools, processes, and culture for the team’s speed and keep the products on the leading edge of what's possible.

jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

**What this job involves:**  

Join JLL as a Business Operations Analyst and take ownership of the operational backbone that keeps our technology group running smoothly. This is a hands\-on operations role – you'll be the person who makes sure contracts get signed, invoices get paid, contractors get onboarded, and the day\-to\-day machinery of a large technology function works without friction. You'll work closely with technology leadership, finance, HR, and vendor partners to run core operational processes end to end, based out of our Bengaluru office.
  
  

**What your day\-to\-day will look like:**  

**Contracting \& procurement:** manage vendor contracts, statements of work, renewals, and procurement requests, working with Legal and Finance to keep agreements current and compliant.
  
**Invoicing \& payments:** process purchase orders and invoices, track approvals, resolve queries with vendors and Finance, and keep payment cycles on track.
  
**Capex accounting:** track capital expenditure against budget, support month\-end and quarter\-end reconciliation, and maintain accurate capex/opex records for the technology group.
  
**Hiring \& onboarding:** coordinate requisition approvals, support recruitment workflows, and manage new\-hire onboarding logistics in partnership with HR.
  
**Team administration:** own team administration processes – calendars, resourcing trackers, org changes, and general administrative support for the technology group.
  
**Townhalls \& team comms:** plan and run monthly townhalls and other team communications – scheduling, logistics, content coordination, and follow\-up actions.
  
**General operations:** support governance routines, reporting cadences, and other operational processes typical of a technology group, stepping in wherever operational support is needed.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

 **Enterprise Digital Transformation Programme** 




  





**Drive the Next Generation of Global Financial Technology** 




 We are looking for an experienced
 **Senior IT Business Analyst** 
 to support the implementation of a large\-scale Global Credit Solution, replacing legacy applications with a centralized SaaS\-based enterprise platform.
 



  





 This role is ideal for professionals who enjoy solving complex business challenges, working with large\-scale technology transformation programmes, and partnering with business and technical stakeholders to deliver innovative digital solutions.
 



  





 You'll play a key role in business process analysis, requirements management, data transformation, and Agile delivery while helping shape the future of enterprise financial systems.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




 Business Analysis
 


* Elicit, analyse, and document complex functional and non\-functional business requirements.
* Translate business needs into detailed solution specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain end\-to\-end traceability throughout the project lifecycle.



 Process \& Data Analysis
 


* Analyse current business processes, workflows, and data landscapes.
* Identify process gaps, operational risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Design future\-state ("to\-be") processes supporting business transformation.



 Agile Delivery
 


* Support Business Analysis activities throughout Agile delivery.
* Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, workshops, and stakeholder reviews.
* Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Architects, Developers, QA teams, and software vendors.



 Stakeholder \& Change Management
 


* Facilitate workshops and design sessions with business stakeholders.
* Communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Support organizational change and business readiness initiatives.



 Testing \& Quality
 


* Define acceptance criteria and business validation processes.
* Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities.
* Ensure delivered solutions meet business objectives and quality standards.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




**Required Qualifications** 




 ✔
 **7–10 years** 
 of experience as an IT Business Analyst.
 



 ✔ Experience delivering large\-scale
 **SaaS, PaaS, or enterprise transformation programmes** 
 .
 



 ✔ Strong experience in requirements gathering, business process analysis, and data analysis.
 



 ✔ Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum or Kanban).
 



 ✔ Strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills.
 



 ✔ Experience collaborating with Architects, Developers, Product Owners, and software vendors.
 



 ✔ Excellent communication skills in English.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




 ⭐ Experience in
 **financial services, commodity trading, credit risk, or enterprise financial systems** 
 .
 



 ⭐ CBAP, CCBA, ECBA, or PMI\-PBA certification.
 



 ⭐ Agile or Scrum certifications.
 



 ⭐ Lean or Continuous Improvement experience.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* Opportunity to contribute to a major enterprise transformation programme.
* Exposure to modern SaaS platforms and global financial systems.
* Collaborative Agile environment with international teams.
* Long\-term opportunity supporting enterprise technology modernization.
* Professional development in business analysis and digital transformation.



  





**Ready to Shape Enterprise Digital Transformation?** 




 If you're passionate about business analysis, Agile delivery, and large\-scale technology transformation, we'd love to hear from you.
 



  





**Apply today and help deliver the next generation of enterprise financial solutions.**
